title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: From the silent gothic halls of Rubenstein to the collaborative labs of the Wilkinson Building, Duke offers a diverse range of environments for focused research and group projects.

cards.title: Gothic Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Rubenstein Library, Floor 2
cards.notes: Enter this silent zone for focused work. No food or drink is permitted except water. Outlets are available at every table under historic gothic arches.
cards.short_summary: A silent, architecturally stunning study hall in the Rubenstein Library dedicated to absolute quiet.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gothic Reading Room is a silent study space where noise, eating, and drinking (except water) are prohibited, and outlets are available at each table.
cards.source_title: Gothic Reading Room – Academic Resource Center - Duke ARC

cards.title: The Edge
cards.subtitle: Bostock Library, Floor 1
cards.notes: Use the Jones Open Lab for collaborative team-based research. The space features mobile furniture, writable wall surfaces, and data visualization labs.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative hub for interdisciplinary and data-driven research located on the first floor of Bostock Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Edge provides collaborative space with writable surfaces, mobile furniture, and project rooms for group research.
cards.source_title: Spaces in the Edge | Duke University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reservable project rooms available for groups of 2-12 people.

cards.title: Brodhead Center
cards.subtitle: West Union
cards.notes: Head to the upper floors for a quieter atmosphere. This central hub offers plenty of seating, reliable Wi-Fi, and easy access to campus dining.
cards.short_summary: A multi-level student center with varied noise levels and extensive seating for social or focused study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Brodhead Center offers various seating options including tables, benches, and couches, with upper floors being quieter for focused work.
cards.source_title: Brodhead Center (WU) – Academic Resource Center - Duke ARC
cards.access_notes: Open 8am-10pm daily; moderate noise level on lower floors.

cards.title: Divinity School Library Zoom Pods
cards.subtitle: Gray Building, BQ-BR Level
cards.notes: Book one of five sound-proof pods for private video calls or online classes. These reservable booths are located upstairs in the Divinity Library.
cards.short_summary: Private, sound-proof booths designed for individual video conferencing and online meetings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Divinity Library has five 'Zoom Pods' on the BQ-BR level that students can book for online classes and meetings.
cards.source_title: Hybrid Students | Duke Divinity School Library
cards.access_notes: Reservable online; open to the larger University community.

cards.title: Medical Center Library Cubicles
cards.subtitle: Seeley G. Mudd Building, Level 2R
cards.notes: Find individual quiet study cubicles on the second and third floors. These spaces are available for Duke-affiliated students on a first-come basis.
cards.short_summary: Individual quiet study stations located within the Duke University Medical Center Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Individual quiet study cubicles are available on Level 2R and Level 3 of the Medical Center Library for Duke-affiliated users.
cards.source_title: Book A Study Room or Cubicle | Duke University Medical Center Library Online
cards.access_notes: Cubicles have no time limit but are subject to a 15-minute grace period for arrival.

cards.title: Wilkinson Building Garage Labs
cards.subtitle: Pratt School of Engineering
cards.notes: Utilize the main floor Garage Labs for hands-on design and active learning. This LEED-certified facility is a hub for engineering entrepreneurship.
cards.short_summary: Modern, hands-on design spaces for engineering students located on the main floor of the Wilkinson Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wilkinson Building features 'Garage Labs' on the main floor for hands-on design and active-learning classrooms.
cards.source_title: Visit | Duke Pratt School of Engineering
cards.access_notes: Open for student use; adjacent to Bseisu Coffee Bar.

cards.title: Goodson Law Library Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Duke Law School, Level 3
cards.notes: Access twelve public computer terminals in this spacious reading room. Duke Card holders can use the space for research and quiet study.
cards.short_summary: A professional research environment with public computer terminals and extensive legal collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The Goodson Law Library Reading Room has twelve computer terminals available for visitors and students during public access hours.
cards.source_title: Public | Duke University School of Law
cards.access_notes: Public access may be limited to Duke Card holders during certain periods; check current hours.

cards.title: Music Library
cards.subtitle: Biddle Music Building, East Campus
cards.notes: Study across two floors of this specialized library. It offers a quiet alternative on East Campus while Lilly Library is under renovation.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, two-story library on East Campus specializing in music resources and study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The Music Library in the Biddle Music Building has study spaces on both floors and is an alternative for East Campus students.
cards.access_notes: Typically open 11am-3pm during summer; check semester hours for extended access.

cards.title: Bella Union
cards.subtitle: McClendon Tower, West Campus
cards.notes: Grab a coffee and find a seat in this cozy, laid-back environment. It is a popular spot for casual study and social work sessions.
cards.short_summary: A relaxed cafe-style study environment located in McClendon Tower on West Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Bella Union is described as a cozy, laid-back spot to get work done on West Campus.
cards.source_title: Bella Union – Academic Resource Center - Duke ARC
cards.access_notes: Open for casual study; food and drink available for purchase.

cards.title: Interview Room Perkins 130
cards.subtitle: Perkins Library, Floor 1
cards.notes: Reserve this specialized room for phone or video interviews. It includes a dedicated telephone line and a quiet, professional setting.
cards.short_summary: A reservable private room in Perkins Library equipped for professional interviews and calls.
cards.evidence_claim: Perkins 130 is a reservable interview room with a telephone (919-660-5959) located on the first floor.
cards.source_title: Find Library Spaces | Duke University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reservable online via the Duke Libraries calendar.
